list.name: traffic
list.label: Traffic
list.description: Live = people and their assistants; Team = our own checks and visits; Tech = scanners and scripts.
list.query: Live : live, Team : team, Tech : tech

panels.title: 1 · Find my area: questions → shortlist → an area → act
Find my area
panels.description: The main happy path. Strict: each step counts people who also did every step before it.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT visitor_id AS who, bool_or(name = 'wizard_open') AS s1, bool_or(name = 'wizard_review') AS s2, bool_or(name = 'wizard_show') AS s3, bool_or(name = 'match_run' AND (props->>'results')::int > 0) AS s4, bool_or(name = 'area_open') AS s5, bool_or(name IN ('portal_click', 'watch_open', 'brief_share')) AS s6 FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1), steps AS (SELECT 1 AS n, '1 opened Find my area' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n, '2 answered the basics' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS n, '3 asked for areas' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS n, '4 got a shortlist' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3 AND s4) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS n, '5 opened an area from it' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3 AND s4 AND s5) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 6 AS n, '6 acted ★' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3 AND s4 AND s5 AND s6) AS people FROM f) SELECT step, people, round(100.0 * people / nullif(first_value(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of start", round(100.0 * people / nullif(lag(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of previous" FROM steps ORDER BY n

panels.title: Look up a place: search → area page → portal
panels.description: For people who already have a place in mind.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT visitor_id AS who, bool_or(name = 'search' AND props->>'kind' <> 'home') AS s1, bool_or(name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' ~ '^/(area|postcode)/') AS s2, bool_or(name = 'portal_click') AS s3 FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1), steps AS (SELECT 1 AS n, '1 searched for a place' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n, '2 opened an area or postcode page' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS n, '3 clicked out to a portal' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3) AS people FROM f) SELECT step, people, round(100.0 * people / nullif(first_value(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of start", round(100.0 * people / nullif(lag(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of previous" FROM steps ORDER BY n

panels.title: Check a home: home → portal or sold prices
panels.description: Someone weighing up a particular home.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT visitor_id AS who, bool_or((name = 'search' AND props->>'kind' = 'home') OR (name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' = '/property/:id')) AS s1, bool_or(name = 'portal_click' AND props->>'from' = 'home') AS s2 FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1), steps AS (SELECT 1 AS n, '1 opened a home' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n, '2 followed its portal links' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2) AS people FROM f) SELECT step, people, round(100.0 * people / nullif(first_value(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of start", round(100.0 * people / nullif(lag(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of previous" FROM steps ORDER BY n

panels.title: 2 · Claude: a conversation from shortlist to listings
Claude conversation
panels.description: Per MCP conversation (a session tag). Step 5 comes from /go links opened by a person.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT session_id AS who, bool_or(name = 'tool_call') AS s1, bool_or(name = 'tool_call' AND props->>'tool' IN ('find_areas', 'match_areas', 'find_similar_areas', 'open_shared_search') AND (props->>'ok')::boolean) AS s2, bool_or(name = 'tool_call' AND props->>'tool' = 'get_area_overview') AS s3, bool_or(name = 'tool_call' AND props->>'tool' = 'get_listing_search_links') AS s4, bool_or(name = 'portal_click') AS s5 FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'mcp' AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1), steps AS (SELECT 1 AS n, '1 used a tool' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n, '2 shortlisted areas' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS n, '3 looked closer at an area' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS n, '4 got listing links' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3 AND s4) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS n, '5 someone opened a listing ★' AS step, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s1 AND s2 AND s3 AND s4 AND s5) AS people FROM f) SELECT step, people, round(100.0 * people / nullif(first_value(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of start", round(100.0 * people / nullif(lag(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of previous" FROM steps ORDER BY n

panels.title: Share and come back
panels.description: Not a strict funnel: each line is its own share of everyone in the period.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT visitor_id AS who, bool_or(name = 'brief_share') AS shared, bool_or(name = 'page_view' AND props ? 'shared') AS opened_shared, bool_or(name IN ('portal_click', 'watch_open', 'brief_share')) AS acted, count(DISTINCT occurred_at::date) AS days FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1), steps AS (SELECT 1 AS n, 'people in the period' AS step, count(*) AS people FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'shared a link', count(*) FILTER (WHERE shared) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'arrived through a shared link', count(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_shared) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 4, '…and then acted ★', count(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_shared AND acted) FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'came back on another day', count(*) FILTER (WHERE days > 1) FROM f) SELECT step, people, round(100.0 * people / nullif(first_value(people) OVER (ORDER BY n), 0)) AS "% of start" FROM steps ORDER BY n

panels.title: 3 · Time to value and entry channels
New people who found an area or home
panels.description: People first seen in the period who opened an area, home or postcode page, or got a shortlist.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT visitor_id, min(occurred_at) AS first_seen, min(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE name = 'area_open' OR (name = 'match_run' AND (props->>'results')::int > 0) OR (name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' ~ '^/(area|property|postcode)/')) AS found_at FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE found_at IS NOT NULL)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM v WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen)

panels.title: Median time to first area
panels.description: From a new person's first page to their first area, home or shortlist.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT visitor_id, min(occurred_at) AS first_seen, min(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE name = 'area_open' OR (name = 'match_run' AND (props->>'results')::int > 0) OR (name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' ~ '^/(area|property|postcode)/')) AS found_at FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM found_at - first_seen)) FROM v WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen) AND found_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: New people who clicked out
panels.description: People first seen in the period who followed a portal link (so far).

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT visitor_id, min(occurred_at) AS first_seen, min(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE name = 'portal_click') AS out_at FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE out_at IS NOT NULL)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM v WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen)

panels.title: Median time to first click-out
panels.description: From a new person's first page to their first portal click: minutes means one sitting, days means they came back.

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT visitor_id, min(occurred_at) AS first_seen, min(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE name = 'portal_click') AS out_at FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM out_at - first_seen)) FROM v WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen) AND out_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Opened Find my area but never asked
panels.description: Opened the questions but never asked for areas.

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (SELECT visitor_id, bool_or(name = 'wizard_open') AS opened, bool_or(name = 'wizard_show') AS showed FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE opened AND NOT showed)::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE opened), 0) FROM f

panels.title: Shortlists with no area
panels.description: Area matches that ranked nothing: the search was too strict.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (props->>'results')::int = 0)::float / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'match_run' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: By entry channel: where people drop off
panels.description: Each person's channel is where their very first visit came from (invite, claude, google, direct…).

targets.rawSql: WITH entry AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (visitor_id) visitor_id, coalesce(props->>'source', 'direct') AS source FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND name = 'page_view' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY visitor_id, occurred_at), f AS (SELECT visitor_id, bool_or(name IN ('search', 'match_run', 'wizard_open')) AS searched, bool_or(name = 'area_open' OR (name = 'match_run' AND (props->>'results')::int > 0) OR (name = 'page_view' AND props->>'path' ~ '^/(area|property|postcode)/')) AS found, bool_or(name = 'portal_click') AS clicked_out, bool_or(name IN ('portal_click', 'watch_open', 'brief_share')) AS acted FROM product_event WHERE coalesce(props->>'traffic', 'live') IN ($traffic) AND channel = 'web' AND visitor_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1) SELECT e.source AS "came from", count(*) AS people, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE searched) / count(*)) AS "searched %", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE found) / count(*)) AS "found %", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE clicked_out) / count(*)) AS "clicked out %", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE acted) / count(*)) AS "acted ★ %" FROM f JOIN entry e USING (visitor_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY people DESC
